package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationqueryproduct/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationqueryproduct/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

func mismatch() {
	relations, _ := project.BindRelations()
	var _ orm.Predicate[authors.Author] = relations.BlogPost.Author.Name.Exact("Ada")
}
